name: Himbrimi Old Tom Gin
production: Recipe based on early-18th-century gin recipes
history: 2013 | Óskar Ericsson makes a homemade gin as a fishing companion (origin of Himbrimi)
nose: Earthy, like Icelandic highlands after rain
palate: Honey and angelica flower sweetness; smooth, slightly bittersweet
notes: Brunnur Distillery founded by Junio Carchini and Óskar Ericsson. BACKLOG MISMATCH: producer listed as Eimverk Distillery, but Gin Guild names Brunnur Distillery [cần kiểm tra]. Launch year not stated.
